+title: 'ComposerSubmitResult.consumed: the host takes the prompt, nothing is sent, the composer clears (D205 /btw)'
+---
+Request from testudoapp-9a (2026-11-19), for `/btw <question>` (D205).
+
+Now: `ComposerSubmitResult` (Sources/AgentViewKit/Input/ComposerSubmit.swift) has `.send`, `.send(addingText:meta:)` and `.cancel`. `.cancel` sends nothing and keeps the text and the files in the composer. `.send` sends the prompt to the session of the thread and clears the composer. The app has no way to take a prompt, send nothing, and clear the composer. It now uses a workaround: select-all and delete on the focused text view (TestudoApp ChatAreaView.swift).
+
+Do:
+- Add `ComposerSubmitResult.consumed`: the host took the prompt. The composer sends nothing to the session of the thread. It clears the composer as a normal send does: the text, the attached files and the mention states clear; the clear is one undo entry; the draft store of the composer is cleared; the prompt history gets the entry if a normal send adds one (follow the send path).
+- Keep the public API additive. Document the three results on `ComposerSubmitResult` and on `onComposerSubmit(_:)`.
+- TDD unit tests: with a hook that returns `.consumed`, no prompt request goes to the session; the text and the files clear; the draft store is empty; one undo restores the text; `.cancel` and `.send` do not change.
+
+Run `swift test`. Push, and send the sha to testudoapp-9a.
\ No newline at end of file

+comments:
+- actor: claude-code
+  id: 01m7rwcqz8nn37bpk66ds7gyr9
+  text: |-
+    Research:
+    - The submit flow is in PromptInputView: `submit()` runs the hook; `.cancel` reports `.notSent` and keeps the text; else `send(_:)` calls `takeInput()` (sets the text binding to empty and the attachment list to []) and then `session.startPrompt(with:accepting:result:)`, reports `.sent`, and calls `onSubmit()`.
+    - The clear is only the binding write. The EditorKit editor pulls the empty text (`pull(_:into:)` -> `model.replaceAll`), which is the one undo entry, and resets its references and mentions. The mention states follow the text.
+    - The draft store (`PromptDraftStore`) holds the text of `DefaultThreadComposer` through the same binding. Thus the binding write clears the draft too.
+    - The kit has no prompt history. The send path adds no entry, so `.consumed` adds none.
+    - Plan: add `isConsumed` and `.consumed` to `ComposerSubmitResult`. Move the result decision into one static function on PromptInputView that takes the bindings and a start closure (the seam for the unit tests). `.cancel` keeps the text, `.consumed` clears and starts nothing, `.send` clears and starts. Add `PromptSubmitOutcome.consumed`.
